versions.changelog:
- Added new Plugin Management functionality with dedicated module and APIs for listing, installing, uninstalling, and uploading Elasticsearch plugins.
- Expanded instance lifecycle operations to support actions like password reset, instance renaming, charge type conversion, version upgrades, and change record queries.
- Introduced support for managing Kibana settings and updating cluster YML configuration.
- Updated intent routing and documentation to reflect new modules and API coverage.
- Removed outdated file (skill-card.md) for clarity.

alibabacloud-elasticsearch-instance-manage 0.0.4

- Added support for Elasticsearch instance-side config management, including snapshot and analyzer dictionary operations.
- Introduced intent-based routing: user queries are dispatched to instance lifecycle or config modules.
- Updated architecture and documentation structure: split core functionality into instance-manage.md and config-manage.md modules.
- Clarified observability/user-agent requirements: each skill session uses a fixed session-id for command attribution.
- Removed obsolete/merged reference files and updated guidance on prerequisites and security practices.

- Increased minimum required Aliyun CLI version to 3.3.3.
- Added requirement to run `aliyun plugin update` and clarified plugin configuration steps.
- Mandated inclusion of a custom User-Agent (`AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-elasticsearch-instance-manage`) with all CLI commands.
- Introduced new AI-Mode configuration steps using `aliyun configure ai-mode` before and after CLI operations.
- Updated and clarified CLI installation, update, and prerequisite instructions for reliability.

alibabacloud-elasticsearch-instance-manage v0.0.2

- Added support for upgrading and downgrading (scaling/resizing) Elasticsearch instance configurations.
- Introduced the UpdateInstance operation for modifying instance resources.
- Expanded triggers to include "upgrade ES", "downgrade ES", "scale ES", "resize ES".
- Updated permissions requirements to include elasticsearch:UpdateInstance.
- Revised documentation to describe new features and workflows.

Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch Instance Management Skill v0.0.1

- Initial release for managing Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch instances.
- Supports creation, description, listing, and restarting of ES instances.
- Secure credential handling enforced; never accept AK/SK directly from users.
- Detailed CLI usage examples and required parameter validations included.
- Offers clear troubleshooting and user guidance for prerequisites and permissions.
